end_minute.title: End Minute

proven_optimal.description: False when the time limit ended the search with a valid but unproven schedule.

changed_shifts.title: Changed Shifts
changed_shifts.description: Logical shifts differing from the base version.

copy_from_version_id.title: Copy From Version Id
copy_from_version_id.description: Version whose shifts start the draft; defaults to base_version_id (empty when both are null).

DemoSession.title: DemoSession
DemoSession.description: Synthetic public demo only; private deployments never expose this endpoint.

EditPreview.title: EditPreview
EditPreview.description:
What the draft would look like after the edits. Nothing is written; the server is the only
authority on validity, cost and coverage.

expected_revision.title: Expected Revision
expected_revision.description: The draft revision the edits were made against.

max_weekly_minutes.title: Max Weekly Minutes
max_weekly_minutes.description: Absolute cap; overtime permission never lifts it.

max_weekly_minutes.title: Max Weekly Minutes
max_weekly_minutes.description: Absolute cap; overtime permission never lifts it.

EmployeeUpdate.title: EmployeeUpdate
EmployeeUpdate.description:
Partial update. Omit a field to leave it unchanged. Sending null for a field that cannot be
null is rejected (422 validation_failed); only preferred_weekly_minutes accepts null, which
clears it.

message.title: Message
message.description: Safe to show to the user.

details.title: Details
details.description: Code-specific structured facts, e.g. field errors or the current revision for stale_version.

trace_id.title: Trace Id
trace_id.description: Quote this when reporting a problem.

base_version_id.title: Base Version Id
base_version_id.description: Current published version the draft replaces; null for an empty week. Stale -> 409.

outlet_id.title: Outlet Id
outlet_id.description: Set for managers and staff; null for owners.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.description: What this caller may do. Use it to show or hide controls; the server still enforces every action.

coverage_ratio.title: Coverage Ratio
coverage_ratio.description: sum(min(assigned, preferred) x minutes) / sum(preferred x minutes). null when there is no demand. Overstaffing never raises it.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.description: Only shifts from current published versions.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills referenced by the shifts, for role labels.

MyWeek.title: MyWeek
MyWeek.description: An employee's own published shifts across all outlets for one week.

open_minute.title: Open Minute
open_minute.description: Minutes from outlet-local midnight; values above 1440 continue past midnight

close_minute.title: Close Minute
close_minute.description: Minutes from outlet-local midnight; values above 1440 continue past midnight

solver_status.title: Solver Status
solver_status.description: Set once solving ends. UNKNOWN means no solution within the time limit; it does not prove infeasibility.

poll_after_ms.title: Poll After Ms
poll_after_ms.description: Suggested polling delay while queued/running; null when terminal.

expected_base_version_id.title: Expected Base Version Id
expected_base_version_id.description: The published version this draft replaces.

scheduled_minutes.title: Scheduled Minutes
scheduled_minutes.description: Paid minutes this week across all outlets' published versions.

revision.title: Revision

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Bumped by every applied edit while the version is a draft; send it as expected_revision. Fixed once published.

schedule_id.title: Schedule Id
schedule_id.description: null when nothing exists for this week yet.

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Rows for the roster: active home-outlet employees plus anyone with a shift in current_version. An employee with no shift on a day is off that day.

absences.title: Absences
absences.description: Absences overlapping this week for listed employees.

id.title: Id
id.description: This version's row. Changes between versions.

logical_shift_id.title: Logical Shift Id
logical_shift_id.description: Stable identity across versions; key diffs on it.

max_assignable.title: Max Assignable
max_assignable.description: Upper bound of eligible staff for this interval.

minimum_required.title: Minimum Required
minimum_required.description: Hard: a roster below this is infeasible.

Move, resize, reassign or change role. Omitted fields keep their value; employee_id may be
null to unassign.

message.description: Deterministic text built from facts; safe to show.

facts.title: Facts
